newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Taleban says takes Afghan province.
newsitem.headline: Taleban says takes Afghan province.

text.p: Afghanistan's Taleban Islamic militia said on Monday it had taken Kapisa province north of the capital Kabul while pursuing the forces of the ousted government of President Burhanuddin Rabbani.

Taleban sources, quoted by a Pakistan-based Afghan news service, said that Kapisa capital Mahmud-i-Raqi and the rest of the province had fallen to the militia on Monday. No details nor confirmation of the report from independent sources were immediately available.
